name: Deore XT standalone V-Brake lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 159 g for the complete left/right BL-M739 V-Brake lever pair with three-step power adjuster. This is the standalone brake-lever pair, not ST-M739 combined shift/brake controls.
